owner_direction.channel: owner instruction in the Claude Code review session (Release-01, 'Evidence-Based Reference Governance & Publication Readiness')
owner_direction.content: Paid external scientific review and professional signatures must not be universal prerequisites for publishing ordinary, low-risk reference content; a proportionate, evidence-based pathway is wanted. This is a direction, not an adoption: the policy takes effect only when a named owner sets status 'adopted' with adopted_by and adopted_on.

verification_levels.not_verified: documentary checks not run or not passed
verification_levels.documentary_verified: every documentary check below passed for every claim of the Knowledge Object. Automated evidence verification; NOT peer review and never labelled as such
verification_levels.independently_human_reviewed: a signed review by a named human who is not the preparer (release_review_policy.json validation_rule). Unchanged.

risk_classes.low_risk_informational: terminology, definitions, nomenclature, historical or linguistic comparison, non-operational scientific explanation, evidence-based conceptual comparison. May use documentary verification.
risk_classes.higher_risk: handling instructions, toxicity or exposure guidance, industrial operating procedures, safety-critical engineering, medical or regulatory-compliance advice, performance or commercial claims. Documentary verification never suffices: independent human review and L6 signatures remain required.
risk_classes.undetermined: anything the evaluator cannot classify with confidence. Treated as higher_risk (fail-closed).

risk_rule: Classified from the actual claims and every author-controlled rendered field, not the page title. The publication candidate must DECLARE low_risk_informational with a rationale; every claim must have an eligible claim_type; the KO must exclude safety and medical claim classes; the required fields (title, h1, summary, SEO title and description, not-established text) must be present; and a sentence-level scan of every field must find no higher-risk signal. Fields assessed (from the renderer's content model, not scraped HTML): title, h1, summary, SEO title and description, JSON-LD string values except identifiers, related-link labels and relations, module headings, paragraphs and table columns/cells, at-a-glance labels and values, synthesis heading, intro, labels and items, the not-established heading and text, and every claim statement. Not assessed as statements: navigation, breadcrumbs, evidence-trail citation metadata, source titles, URLs. Operational guidance (imperatives, dosage/concentration/temperature quantities) is always a signal; a risk keyword in a sentence that only declares a topic out of scope is exempt unless that sentence instructs or quantifies. Keyword signals cannot establish safety or technical correctness: they only route content away from this pathway. Any gap yields undetermined (fail-closed).

documentary_checks.D1_claims: every claim bound to the KO exists, is approved (narrow) in its registry, has an eligible claim_type, and lists supporting evidence that the KO binds; no pending or rejected claim is bound
documentary_checks.D2_evidence: every bound evidence record is governed, evidence_verified, and admitted by admissible() for its declared use (renderer admission)
documentary_checks.D3_scope: each record's intended use is within its source-use qualification and the record's allowed uses (claim within the cited source's scope)
documentary_checks.D4_reproducible: source-lock checklist L1-L5 pass for every source behind the KO: identity verified, captured with sha256 and verbatim passages, reproduced on a later date, version pinned, quotation scope
documentary_checks.D5_conflicts: no evidence or claim is flagged as an unresolved material contradiction, and where the KO has unresolved fields the reference states them (an 'open' synthesis group and a 'not established' section)
documentary_checks.D6_quality: Gate 12 PASS on the canonical draft with at least the minimum valid IG units, and a recorded distinctiveness review

what_documentary_verification_replaces.validation_posture: 'validated' may be honoured by documentary_verified INSTEAD OF a signed independent review, for low_risk_informational KOs, once this policy is adopted
what_documentary_verification_replaces.evidence_posture: 'evidence_locked' may be honoured by documentary acceptance of every source (L1-L5 pass) INSTEAD OF L6 human signatures, for low_risk_informational KOs, once this policy is adopted. L6 is never marked signed; source_lock_status stays 'candidate'.

what_it_never_replaces: any requirement for higher_risk or undetermined content
version_note: 1.0.0 (2026-10-31): D7 field coverage completed before adoption; no change to D1-D6 or to what the pathway may replace.
